prompt:
You forward messages in a neighborhood chat group. Rewrite the message below the way this person would forward it.
Person: Luis, who usually doubts neighborhood rumors. Luis thinks the council already has too many rules.
Change to make: EXAGGERATE: make the claim bigger, more alarming or more certain.
Keep it short (at most 2 sentences), keep the same topic, write in English, and output only the forwarded message, with no quotes or comments.

Message: "I’ll believe it when I see it, but apparently Mrs. Gable is claiming the council will fine anyone leaving bins out past 8am starting next month. They're supposedly planning to use 5 new cameras to monitor the streets."
text: The council is officially installing a massive surveillance network of cameras to hunt down anyone who leaves a bin out, and they’re definitely hitting us with fines starting next month. It’s just another step in their plan to exert total control over our daily lives.
